overall_notes: The paper presents a comprehensive study of text-free image-to-speech synthesis. The extraction was generally accurate but missed some important datasets and evaluation methods. The paper introduces a novel M-SPICE metric for evaluating semantic diversity in generated captions. Human evaluation was well-documented with both MOS ratings and preference tests.
